<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0; text-align: right"><B>Exhibit 10.3</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>EXCLUSIVE LICENSE AND
DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">This Exclusive License and Distribution Agreement
(this &ldquo;Agreement&rdquo;) is entered into as of this 2<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">nd </FONT>of January, 2025 (the &ldquo;Effective
Date&rdquo;), by and between CS Interpharm General Trading Co. LLC, a Dubai entity (the &ldquo;Licensor,&rdquo; or &ldquo;CSI&rdquo;)
and CS Diagnostics, Corp., a Wyoming corporation, with its principal address at Stresemannallee 4c, Neuss, Germany 41460 (the &ldquo;Licensee,&rdquo;
or &ldquo;CSDX&rdquo;). Licensor and Licensee are collectively referred hereto as &ldquo;Parties&rdquo; and each individually as &ldquo;Party.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; text-indent: 0in">RECITALS</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">WHEREAS, Licensor owns certain intellectual property, know-how, proprietary
information, and related</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">rights concerning the product described in Exhibit A (the &ldquo;Product&rdquo;);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">WHEREAS, Licensor desires to grant Licensee the
exclusive right to use, market, distribute, and commercialize the Product solely within the United States of America, subject to the
terms and conditions of this Agreement; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">WHEREAS, Licensee desires to obtain such exclusive rights from Licensor
for its internal business purposes, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual
covenants, terms, and conditions set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which
are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 27pt">1.</TD><TD>Definitions</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&ldquo;<B><I>Affiliate</I></B>&rdquo; means any entity directly or
indirectly controlling, controlled by, or under common control with</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">a Party.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&ldquo;<B><I>Intellectual Property</I></B>&rdquo; means patents, trademarks,
copyrights, trade secrets, know-how, technical data, formulae, designs, and other proprietary rights owned by CSI and related to the
Product.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&ldquo;<B><I>Net Sales</I></B>&rdquo; means gross amounts invoiced
by CSDX or its sublicensees from the sale of Products in the</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Territory, less customary deductions (returns, chargebacks, taxes,
shipping).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&quot;<B><I>Person</I></B>&quot; means an individual, corporation,
partnership, joint venture, limited liability entity, governmental authority, unincorporated organization, trust, association, or other
entity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&ldquo;<B><I>Territory</I></B>&rdquo; means the United States of America
and its territories and possessions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 27pt">2.</TD><TD>Grant of License</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt"><B>2.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</B><U>Exclusive
License</U>. Licensor grants Licensee the exclusive right and license to use, import, market, promote, distribute, and sell the Product
in the Territory during the Term<B>.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">2.2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>License
Restrictions</U>. Except as this Agreement expressly permits<B>, </B>Licensee shall not, and shall not permit any other Person to:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">2.2.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;transfer
any ownership rights in the Intellectual Property, such remains with Licensor;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">2.2.2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rent,
lease, lend, sell, sublicense, assign, distribute, transfer, or otherwise make available the Product to any third party; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">2.2.3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;grant
sublicenses without the prior written consent of Licensor.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">2.3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Intellectual
Property Rights</U>. Licensee acknowledges and agrees that the Product are licensed, not sold, to Licensee by Licensor and Licensee does
not have under or in connection with this Agreement any ownership interest in the Product, or in any related Intellectual Property rights.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2px solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>

    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">2.4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Licensee
Cooperation and Notice of Infringement</U>. Licensee shall, during the Term, take all commercially reasonable measures to safeguard the
Product from infringement, misappropriation, theft, misuse, or unauthorized access.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">2.5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>No
Other Grant of Rights</U>. Except as expressly provided herein, nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to confer upon Licensee
any ownership interest, license, or other rights by implication, estoppel, or otherwise in or to any intellectual property rights, products,
technology, or biological materials of Licensor or any third party, regardless of whether such rights, products, technology, or materials
are known to Licensee at the Effective Date or become known thereafter. All rights not expressly granted to Licensee under this Agreement
are expressly reserved by Licensor.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 27pt">3.</TD><TD>Confidentiality</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">3.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Confidential
Information</U>. In connection with this Agreement, each Party (the &quot;Disclosing Party&quot;) may disclose or make available Confidential
Information to the other Party (the &quot;Receiving Party&quot;). Subject to Section 3.2, &quot;Confidential Information&quot; means
confidential information belonging to the Disclosing Party and its Affiliates that are not generally known to the public, including,
but not limited to, information concerning the Property, business plans, financial statements, and other information provided pursuant
to this Agreement, operating practices and methods, expansion plans, strategic plans, marketing plans, contracts, customer lists, or
other business documents that the Disclosing Party treats as confidential, in any format whatsoever (including oral, written, electronic,
or any other form or medium).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">3.2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Exclusions</U>.
Confidential Information does not include information that: (a) was rightfully known to the Receiving Party without restriction on use
or disclosure prior to such information being disclosed or made available to the Receiving Party in connection with this Agreement; (b)
was or becomes generally known by the public other than by the Receiving Party's or any of its Representatives' noncompliance with this
Agreement; (c) was or is received by the Receiving Party on a non-confidential basis from a third party that was not or is not, at the
time of such receipt, under any obligation to maintain its confidentiality; or (d) was or is independently developed by the Receiving
Party without reference to or use of any Confidential Information.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Notwithstanding any other provisions of this
Agreement, the Receiving Party's obligations under this Section 3 with respect to any Confidential Information that constitutes a trade
secret under any applicable Law will continue until such time, if ever, as such Confidential Information ceases to qualify for trade
secret protection under one or more such applicable Laws other than as a result of any act or omission of the Receiving Party or any
of its Representatives.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">3.3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Compelled
Disclosures</U>. If the Receiving Party or any of its Representatives is compelled by applicable Law to disclose any Confidential Information
then, to the extent permitted by applicable Law, the Receiving Party will: (a) promptly, and prior to such disclosure, notify the Disclosing
Party in writing of such requirement so that the Disclosing Party can seek a protective order or other remedy or waive its rights under
Section 3.3; and (b) provide reasonable assistance to the Disclosing Party in opposing such disclosure or seeking a protective order
or other limitations on disclosure. If the Disclosing Party waives compliance or, after providing the notice and assistance required
under this Section 3, the Receiving Party remains required by applicable law to disclose any Confidential Information, the Receiving
Party will disclose only that portion of the Confidential Information that, on the advice of the Receiving Party's legal counsel, the
Receiving Party is legally required to disclose.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2px solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: left; width: 100%"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">&nbsp;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 27pt">4.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Obligations</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">4.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Licensor</U>.
Licensor shall:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">4.1.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;provide
Licensee with access to technical information, regulatory data, and other know-how reasonably necessary for Licensee to commercialize
the Product in the Territory.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">4.1.2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;maintain
and protect Intellectual Property at its expense, including patent filings and renewals, whether within the Territory or globally.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">4.1.3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;not,
during the Term, license, sell, assign, or transfer the Product in the Territory to any other Person.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">4.1.4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cooperate
and provide all necessary documentation and technical support.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">4.2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Licensee</U>.
Licensee shall:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">4.2.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;use
commercially reasonable efforts to market and sell the Product in the Territory.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">4.2.2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;obtain
and maintain all regulatory approvals (<I>e.g.</I>, FDA, EPA, or other U.S. agencies) necessary for the lawful commercialization of the
Product in the Territory.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">4.2.3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;provide
quarterly sales, revenue, and regulatory progress reports to Licensor.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">4.2.4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;comply
with all applicable laws and regulations in the Territory.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">4.2.5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sponsor
any U.S. regulatory applications and approvals. Notwithstanding any other provisions set forth herein, all U.S. regulatory approvals
shall be held in Licensee&rsquo;s name but licensed use of Licensor&rsquo;s data shall remain the Licensor&rsquo;s property.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 27pt">5.</TD><TD>Mutual Representation and Warranties</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">5.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Each
Party represents, warrants, and covenants to the other Party that:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">5.1.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;it
is duly organized, validly existing and in good standing as a corporation or other entity under the Laws of the jurisdiction of its incorporation
or other organization;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">5.1.2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;it
has the full right, power, and authority to enter into and perform its obligations and grant the rights, licenses, and authorizations
it grants and is required to grant under this Agreement;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">5.1.3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;the
execution of this Agreement by its representative whose signature is set forth at the end of this Agreement has been duly authorized
by all necessary corporate or organizational action of such Party; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 27.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">5.1.4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;when
executed and delivered by both Parties, this Agreement will constitute the legal, valid, and binding obligation of such Party, enforceable
against such Party in accordance with its terms.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 27pt">6.</TD><TD>Fees</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">6.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Royalties</U>.
Licensee shall pay Licensor a royalty of _2.5_% of Net Sales of the Product in the Territory, payable quarterly within 30 days after
the end of each calendar quarter.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">6.2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Upfront
or Annual Fee</U>. Licensee shall pay Licensor an upfront license fee of $ 20,000 upon execution of this Agreement, and thereafter an
annual license maintenance fee of $_5000 .</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">6.3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Audit
Rights</U>. Licensor may, no more than once per year, audit Licensee&rsquo;s books and records relating to Product sales in the Territory,
at Licensor&rsquo;s expense (unless an underpayment of more than 5% is discovered, in which case Licensee shall bear the audit cost).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 27pt">7.</TD><TD>Term and Termination</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">7.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Term</U>.
This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for ten (10) years (the</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&ldquo;Term&rdquo;), unless terminated earlier in accordance with
this Section 7.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">7.2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Termination
for Cause</U>. Either Party may terminate this Agreement upon 60 days&rsquo; written notice</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">if the other Party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to
cure within such period.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">7.3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Termination
for Insolvency</U>. Either Party may terminate if the other Party becomes insolvent, files for bankruptcy, or ceases operations.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">7.4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Effect
of Termination</U>. Upon termination, Licensee shall cease all use of the Product and Intellectual Property in the Territory, return
or destroy Licensor&rsquo;s confidential information, and discontinue all sales. Unsold inventory shall be handled as agreed by the Parties.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: left; width: 100%"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">&nbsp;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 27pt">8.</TD><TD>Enforcement of Intellectual Property Rights</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">8.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Right
to Enforce</U>. During the Term, Licensee shall have the exclusive right, at its own expense, to enforce its rights under this Agreement
against any third party that (i) directly or indirectly imports, markets, distributes, or sells the Product in the Territory without
authorization, or (ii) otherwise interferes with Licensee&rsquo;s exclusive rights in the Territory.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">8.2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Notice</U>.
Licensee shall promptly notify Licensor of any such actual or threatened infringement or interference of which it becomes aware.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">8.3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Licensor
Cooperation</U>. Licensor shall reasonably cooperate with Licensee, at Licensee&rsquo;s expense,</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">in connection with any such enforcement action, including joining
as a necessary party if required by law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">8.4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Recovery</U>.
Any recovery obtained in connection with such action shall be first applied to reimburse the enforcing Party&rsquo;s reasonable costs
and expenses, and the balance, if any, shall be shared as determined by Parties.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">8.5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Licensor&rsquo;s
Reserved Rights</U>. Licensor retains the right, at its discretion and expense, to bring or assume control of any enforcement action
relating to its Intellectual Property outside the Territory.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 27pt">9.</TD><TD>Miscellaneous</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">9.1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Further
Assurances</U>. On a Party's reasonable request, the other Party shall, at the requesting Party's sole cost and expense, execute and
deliver all such documents and instruments, and take all such further actions, as may be necessary to give full effect to this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">9.2&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Relationship
of the Parties</U>. The relationship between the Parties is that of independent contractors. Nothing contained in this Agreement will
be construed as creating any agency, partnership, joint venture, or other form of joint enterprise, employment, or fiduciary relationship
between the Parties, and neither Party shall have authority to contract for or bind the other Party in any manner whatsoever.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">9.3&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Governing
Law</U>. This Agreement shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of Wyoming applicable to the terms
set forth in this Agreement. The Parties hereto hereby consent to the jurisdiction of the state courts located in the State of Wyoming
over the Parties and any disputes, claims, actions, suits and proceedings related to this agreement or the transactions contemplated
herein.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">9.4&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Other
Agreements</U>. The Parties each represents to the other that it is not a party to any other agreements or commitments that would hinder
its performance or cause any conflicting interests from his/her obligations under this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">9.5&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Construction</U>.
The Parties have participated jointly in the negotiation and drafting of this Agreement. In the event an ambiguity or question of intent
or interpretation arises, this Agreement will be construed as if drafted jointly by the Parties and no presumption or burden of proof
will arise favoring or disfavoring any Parties by virtue of the authorship of any of the provisions of this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">9.6&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Arbitration</U>.
Any dispute, controversy or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement or any breach or alleged breach hereof shall, upon
the request of any party involved, be submitted to, and settled by, arbitration in the city in which the principal place of business
of the Licensor is then located. Any award rendered shall be final and conclusive upon the parties and a judgment thereon may be entered
in a court of competent jurisdiction. The expenses of the arbitration shall be borne equally by the parties to the arbitration, provided
that each party shall pay for and bear the cost of its own experts, evidence and attorneys&rsquo; fees, except that in the discretion
of the arbitrator any award may include the attorney&rsquo;s fees of a party if the arbitrator expressly determines that the party against
whom such award is entered has caused the dispute, controversy or claim to be submitted to arbitration as a dilatory tactic or in bad
faith.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">9.7&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Notices</U>.
All notifications and communications hereunder shall be in writing. All notifications made to the Licensor under this Agreement shall
be made to the following address:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">To: CS Interpharm General Trading Co. LLC<BR>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">All notifications made to the Licensee under this Agreement shall
be made to the following address:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">To: CS Diagnostics, Corp.&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">9.8&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Severability</U>.
In the event any one or more of the provisions of this agreement is held to be invalid or otherwise unenforceable, the enforceability
of the remaining provisions shall be unimpaired.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">9.9&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Amendment</U>.
This Agreement, in part or in whole, may not be altered, amended, changed, supplemented, waived or modified in any respect or particular
unless the same shall be in writing and agreed to by the affirmative vote or written consent of all Parties.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">9.10&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Entire
Agreement</U>. This Agreement represents the entire understanding of the Parties superseding all prior agreements, understandings, and
discussions whether conveyed orally or in writing, and there are no other warranties, commitments, understandings or representations
with respect to this agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have executed this Exclusive
License and Distribution Agreement as of the date set forth above.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
